title: Evening Round: write the third phrase
intro: Here are the first two phrases of a round for three voices. Write the third so all three fit together. The chords under every phrase are I – V – I – I, two beats each (F, C, F, F).
source: Written for Canon Workbench as a practice piece.
hints: On beats 1 and 3, use a note of the chord: F–A–C for I, C–E–G for V.
The other phrases sit around A4–C5. Write lower, between E4 and A4, so the voices don't collide.
Move where the others hold still: the first phrase uses long notes, so add some quarter or eighth notes.
